scope: Common SteamVR transport prepares the next real image while the prior released generation is retained by EndFrame; defer native Release until its completed FIFO packet is selected by the physical consumer. Physical period read uses an atomic observer snapshot.
headset_validation: Pending fresh MSFS2024 comparison. The shared non-scene preparation gate is proven and regression-tested; actual delivered FPS recovery and unrelated runtime/GPU stalls remain unmeasured.
owner_evidence: V586 PID23308 detailed ring retains only final Fidelity segment 117.069657-137.368640s. In25 ordinary copy-late gaps, preparation starts5-13us after prior End returns although source is ready13-21ms earlier and scene chains are disjoint from prior packet. This proves a shared non-scene image lease blocks preparation. Its recurrence matches the250ms overlay refresh, but the log does not identify the exact quad handle. Median acquire/wait29us, copy submission43.8us, copy-fence completion observation8.91255ms. These are CPU observations, not isolated GPU execution duration. Giant526ms copy observation overlaps100ms native Wait/412ms End and an OpenVR poll; causation is not established.
ownership: One successfully waited unreleased target per real chain. Preparer acquires/waits/copies/fence-completes it ahead of delivery. Consumer releases only its completed FIFO head before EndFrame. Retain old generations until all their packets finish End; same physical image index waits those users before overwriting. Immutable images share their generation; static image uses a single acquisition/release across drained packets and stop/start. Stop drains submitted work and resolves held real-image ownership.
validation: Actual D3D11/D3D12 GPU resources with mocked downstream OpenXR: same-chain lookahead during blocked End, updated-overlay old/new pixel readback, runtime physical-index reuse/cancel, held-target stop/restart, static repeat/stop/restart; existing strict physical cadence, bounded FIFO, source-fence independence, routes, flags, meter, UI and single-INI checks. This does not emulate MSFS GPU contention or prove headset scanout.
observer: Director reads cached_display_period via atomic load only: no observer mutex, OpenVR attach or runtime query. Application observer refreshes the same physical-Hz cache, including F9/UI-off operation, using try_lock. Unknown cache uses existing native prediction fallback. Optional statistics cannot hold the director merely to read Hz.
diagnostics: Stage5715 now means copy complete with real target still waited/unreleased. Native release follows on the consumer before that packet End. Stages5722/5723/5724 remain F9-only CPU observations of acquired/waited targets, copy submitted and observed copy-fence completion. No optional GPU query resources added.
